To onboard a new supplier:

5. **Orders**: No orders may be placed until all required documents (and lithium-cell certificates, if applicable) are on file [1].

The process normally takes five working days from a complete file [1][5].

records.answer:
When a UN 38.3 certificate is approaching expiry:

- **90 days before expiry:** On the first working day of the month, the senior buyer identifies expiring certificates using report `JOB-PUR-022` (90-day window) and writes to the supplier using letter template `NBC-L-07` to request a new test report [1].
- **60 days before expiry:** If no report has arrived, a second reminder is sent and the purchase manager is notified [1]. Under amendment `AMD-SUP-2026-02`, no new order may be raised once fewer than 60 days remain [1].
- **On expiry:** An e-mail is sent to all buyers with the subject `CERT EXPIRED - DO NOT ORDER`, the supplier’s name, and code [1]. The supplier remains ACTIVE, but no lithium-cell parts may be ordered until a new certificate is uploaded and checked [3]. Because Ledgerline does not automatically stop orders, the person raising the order and the approver must enforce this check [3].
